Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely accepted the Wikipedia lead’s claim that Vincent Novello was “born in Piedmont, Italy” without reconciling the same page’s internal contradiction (“born at 240 Oxford Street,” i.e., London) or prioritizing authoritative sources first.
